[P2] Reconcile canonical numeric displays with exact expectations

For a service result of `1e4096`, `_display_json()` produces the string `"1e4096"` because the integer exceeds its 4096-digit display limit. An independently declared expectation of `10**4096` has the same fingerprint, but `_same_checkpoint_display()` rejects the string-versus-number comparison. Thus an exact matching result produces an assertion failure. After verifying the fingerprint, compare against the expectation's corresponding display projection, preserving the distinction from an actual JSON string. Add coverage for this out-of-range display case.
